messages:
ana: Quick idea 1 1 Set up a 'Pocket Kudos' kiosk at the next all-hands foyer: instant handwritten note cards + tiny token (pin or sticker). low fuss, high delight.
devin: Love it. what's the minimum kit we need? table, tub of cards, pens, lapel pins (or stickers), sign, volunteer to man it for 20 mins?
sam: Ops can supply a folding table and clip-on sign holder. I can bring the card stock and pens from supplies closet.
nana: (typo: ana) I'll handle the card template and short script for volunteers. thinking prompt: "Who made your day this week? 1 sentence."
spotlight-bot: Reminder: ordered physical swag usually needs 5 business days. rush +48h is available at extra cost.
devin: Quick cost check: 120 enamel pins $300 est, 200 sheets of stickers $50, printed 4x6 cards $18, signage $12, shipping $30. total ~ $410.
finance: That fits within Events small spend. Please route to card and attach receipt.
sam: Volunteer plan: cover 3 shifts of 15 mins across the event peak. who can staff?
nana: I can do the first shift and the post-event packdown. also I'll make a very small sign that says: "Pocket Kudos 30 1-line note = big thanks"
devin: I'll coordinate pin vs sticker decision after seeing lead times. if pins are slow, go sticker-first. also will request vendor proof for pin art by Tues.
spotlight-bot: ACTION: upload final pin art and qty by Tue 11:00 to avoid rush fees.
sam: Accessibility note: we'll place the kiosk in an accessible spot and offer volunteers to transcribe if someone wants to dictate. add that to the sign.
nana: Also propose a QR code linking to the digital kudos form for remote folks. I'll add the QR link to the back of cards.
devin: small ops ask: avoid loose confetti near the AV cables. :grimacing:
finance: After purchase, share the expense code and receipt. thanks.
spotlight-bot: Post-event reminder: collect 2 quotes for social + a photo.
nana: Plan checklist: card template (ana), sign + QR (ana), pin/sticker order (devin), vendor proof (devin), table + setup (sam), volunteer slots (sam). I'll post the signup link by Mon.
devin: I'll ping vendor today. if we can't get pins in time, we'll do limited pin giveaway (first 50) and keep stickers for everyone.
sam: Great. I'll reserve the foyer table and put a temporary floor badge so people can find it.
nana: Thanks all  will post mockups and the signup sheet Monday AM. excited! :sparkles:
